blocks.text: Kuch jagahon par lymph vessels mein connective tissue ke dher hote hain jin mein lymphocytes maujood hote hain. Inhen lymph nodes kehte hain. Kai afferent (andar lane wali) lymph vessels ek lymph node mein dakhil hoti hain, aur lymph sirf ek efferent (bahar le jane wali) lymph vessel se bahar nikalti hai. Insan mein lymph nodes gardan, baghal (axilla) aur raan ke jor (groin) mein hote hain. Lymph nodes ke ilawa kai lymphoid masses mukhtalif jagahon par hote hain, maslan alimentary canal ki mucosa aur submucosa (andar ki parat aur us ke neeche ki tah) mein. Bare lymphoid masses tilli (spleen), thymus, tonsils aur adenoids hain. Yeh lymphocytes banate hain.

blocks.alt: Gol lymph node jis ka hara capsule lymphocytes aur macrophages ke khanon ko gherta hai. Kinare par kai lymph vessels (lymphatics) lymph andar late hain; oopar ek lymph vessel lymph ko bahar le jati hai, aur saath khoon ki naliyon ka jora hai jahan se khoon aata aur jata hai.

blocks.explanation: Blood capillaries interstitial fluid tissues mein risati rehti hain, aur zaid aam taur par lymph capillaries mein jata aur skeletal muscles ke sukar, viscera ki harkat aur saans se valve wali lymph vessels mein oopar dhakela jata hai. Khara rehna taangon ka muscle pump hata deta hai, to takhnon se lymph ka bahao sust ho jata hai, zaid mayah subclavian veins ko kafi jaldi nahin lautta, aur tissues mein soojan ke taur par jama ho jata hai.

items: Lymphatic system = lymph vessels, lymphoid masses, lymph nodes aur lymph; tissues se izafi mayah aur proteins wapas khoon mein lata hai aur jism ki hifazat karta hai.

Interstitial fluid band sire wali, zyada permeable lymph capillaries mein ja kar lymph banta hai → lymph vessels → right lymphatic duct aur thoracic duct → daen aur baen subclavian veins. Bahao muscles, viscera aur saans se chalta hai; valves wapsi rokte hain.
Roz taqreeban 3 litre izafi mayah lymph ke zariye khoon mein wapas aata hai. Villi ke lacteals chylomicrons lete hain.

Lymph nodes (gardan, baghal, groin; kai afferent aur ek efferent vessel) lymph chhaante hain; tilli khoon chhaanti, purane RBCs khatam aur RBCs zakhira karti hai. Tilli, thymus, tonsils aur adenoids lymphocytes banate hain.
